parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-07 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 2831.4 | 17.20 | 17.20
2 | 3567.9 | 2.07 | 19.27
3 | 3454.3 | 21.64 | 40.91
4 | 11701.4 | 4.12 | 45.03
5 | 140416.4 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-07
Curve type: KHA
Aquifer depth: 19.27 - 40.91 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of approximately 45 m to fully penetrate the weathered aquifer zone and terminate upon reaching the resistive bedrock. Install well screens within the 19.3–40.9 m interval for optimal yield.
